name: Tide Weather
description: Weather forecast query via dual-source fallback (Open-Meteo primary, wttr.in backup).
description_cn: 天气预报查询，双源降级（Open-Meteo 优先，wttr.in 备选）。

directives.description: Query weather forecast for a city on a specific date
directives.description_cn: 查询指定城市和日期的天气预报

params_desc.date: Date keyword: today/tomorrow/day after tomorrow, or 今天/明天/后天
params_desc.city: City name in Chinese or English: 威海/Beijing/London/東京
